entities.name: Basil
entities.description: Basil is a dark skinned human citizen of Capenna who is a gossip and member of the Cabaretti family, with black hair, a mustache, and flamboyant dress.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: A family of New Capenna to which Basil belongs.

entities.name: Zora
entities.description: Zora is a human woman citizen of Capenna with a fascination for spiders.
